contract.goal: This month's invoices from the office's own books: one print-ready invoice per billable client with ledger-true amounts, numbers that continue the sequence with no skip or repeat, and due dates per each client's terms, plus a one-page summary of what went out and who was skipped.

deliverables.description: The one-page run summary: each invoice with number, client, amount and due date, the total billed, the number range issued, and the clients skipped this month
The month's invoices: one print-ready HTML file per billable client in the invoices folder

criteria.text: The invoices folder holds an HTML invoice for each billable client
report.md is a one-page summary under headings that states the total billed
report.md has a "Skipped clients" section naming every roster client not billed this month and why, or "none"
Every amount traces to an uninvoiced ledger entry, no client is invented or left out, and the total adds up from the invoices

judge.rubric: Does every invoice amount match an uninvoiced ledger entry for that client, with no invented or missing client, and does the summary total equal the sum of the invoices?

criteria.text: Invoice numbers continue the last issued number with no skip or repeat, and each due date follows that client's terms

judge.rubric: Do the invoice numbers continue the ledger's last issued number with no gap or repeat, and does each due date follow that client's payment terms?

criteria.text: Each invoice shows the client and contact, its number and due date, line items and a total, and is styled to print cleanly (@page and print styles)

judge.rubric: Does each invoice show the client and contact, invoice number, due date, line items and a total that re-adds, with print styles (@page or @media print) so it prints cleanly?
